name: @animastor/generation
description: Animastor Generation — the media-generation domain core of the Animastor backend, physically extracted from the host: the media capability registry (audio/image/video capability seam), the pure generation task registry, the per-asset state FSM contract, the canonical artifact filename grammar, the shared prompt-assembly profile resolver with character-reference normalizers, and the single Generation→ComfyUI/GPU provider seam (Job Protocol v2 dispatch). The package reaches the host (dispatch transport, runtime config slices, assembly profile files, book scene data) ONLY through the four frozen S-6 ports — no Redis, no PG, no filesystem, no Express, no runtime-config, no backend/src require inside.
